_readme: Predefined inputs for Install-NeologikEnvironment.ps1. Copy this file to 'inputs.json' (auto-detected next to the script) or pass its path with -AnswerFile. Every value here pre-fills the matching prompt: press Enter to accept, or type to override. This file holds configuration inputs plus two provisioning switches (skipGuestInvitation, useExistingServicePrincipal and its object ID/secret); the CLI switches -SkipGuestInvitation / -ExistingServicePrincipalObjectId take precedence when passed. Runtime decisions (Terms acceptance, PowerShell/module install, re-auth, quota/permission warnings) are always asked interactively and are never read from here. Replace every REPLACE_ME / example value below before use. Remove any field to fall back to its built-in default (for default fields) or to be prompted with no pre-fill (for per-client fields).
organizationCode: REPLACE_ME — client 3-letter code, lowercase, e.g. abc
organizationName: REPLACE_ME — full company name, e.g. Contoso Ltd
fqdn: REPLACE_ME — bot's full hostname (FQDN), e.g. neologik.contoso.com
_naming_note: Optional resource-name overrides for client-specific naming conventions. Remove any of these to accept the computed Neologik-standard name. keyVaultName: 3-24 chars, letters/digits/hyphens, starts with a letter. storageAccountName: 3-24 chars, lowercase letters/digits only. scriptRunnerIdentityName: 3-128 chars, letters/digits/hyphens/underscores, starts with a letter or digit.
_existingServicePrincipalSecret_note: Prefer the -ExistingServicePrincipalSecret CLI parameter (masked, not written to disk) over storing a client secret in this file. If set here, it is used; leave blank to be prompted (or to skip and add it to Key Vault manually).
_v5_note: Agents (bots) are no longer created at onboarding - they are created post-deployment in the Neologik Harness admin tool. botCount/bots keys from older kits are ignored.
